drills.name: Quadriceps Stretch (Standing)
drills.description: Standing quad stretch to improve hip flexor mobility and quad flexibility after training
drills.technique_notes: Stand on one leg, pull opposite foot toward glutes, keep knee pointing down, lean forward slightly for deeper stretch, no bouncing

drills.name: Hamstring Stretch (Standing Forward Bend)
drills.description: Standing hamstring stretch with forward bend to lengthen posterior chain
drills.technique_notes: Feet hip-width apart, hinge at hips, let arms hang, slight knee bend if needed, reach toward toes

drills.name: Hip Flexor Stretch (Low Lunge)
drills.description: Low lunge position to stretch hip flexors and improve anterior hip mobility
drills.technique_notes: Step one foot forward into lunge, drop back knee down, press hips forward, hands on front knee

drills.name: Glute/Piriformis Stretch (Pigeon Pose)
drills.description: Deep glute and external rotator stretch to reduce sciatic nerve tension
drills.focus: Gluteus Maximus, Piriformis, Hip External Rotators
drills.technique_notes: Sit with one leg bent in front, opposite leg extended behind, lean forward from hips, keep chest tall
